transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the routine technical and safety huddle for the feature screening. I'd like to review the draft run sheet together before I give my final approval on the venue operating plan. I have the screening placed in Hall A with a 180-person audience capacity, Q&A recording for the festival archive, and standard two-way audience movement. I'd like to hear from the projection supervisor and the safety and insurance coordinator on any concerns or adjustments needed before I sign off.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we proceed. I checked the distributor portal this morning, and the current KDM is authorized only for Hall B's secure projector — not Hall A. This portal update arrived after the technical run sheet was circulated, so the draft plan placing us in Hall A with Q&A recording conflicts with both the KDM's venue authorization and its no-camera condition.
